data.description:
## Context / Problem

S7 (2c66-205d-92e1-4419) emits the echo-safe parent-drift breadcrumb from `outbound_comments._diff_comments`, appended after the resolved Jira dedup set is built. In the **snapshot path** (production's primary source — the snapshot carries the `comment` field) this works even when the child has zero local comments. But in the **live-search path** (snapshot lacks the `comment` field), `_diff_comments` early-returns `[]` at the `if not local_comments:` guard (outbound_comments.py ~line 635) BEFORE `_build_parent_breadcrumb` is reached. So a drift-affected child with no local comments — exactly the under-defined-leaf case the breadcrumb targets — gets no breadcrumb in that fallback path.

Raised as a non-blocking advisory on Gerrit change 2091 (S7 LLM review).

## Why deferred from S7

The narrow safe fix is: in the live-search path, when `not local_comments` but a client IS available and the drift condition may apply, still fetch comments (for the append-once dedup) and emit the breadcrumb. The client-None and fetch-failed returns must stay (bug-4292 safety: never blind-add when Jira comment state is unknown). Implementing this inline adds a branch to `_diff_comments`, which is already at the McCabe complexity ceiling (the S7 implementer used `mutations.extend(...)` specifically to avoid tripping the ratchet). A correct fix therefore needs a behavior-preserving extraction, too large to fold safely into the S7 landing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A drift-affected bound child with zero local comments and an available transport client receives exactly one breadcrumb in the live-search path (snapshot lacks `comment`), append-once against the live-fetched comment set.
- [ ] The client-None and live-fetch-failure paths still emit no breadcrumb (bug-4292 unknown-state safety preserved).
- [ ] `_diff_comments` stays under the complexity ratchet (fix via extraction, not a baseline bump).
data.title: Parent-drift breadcrumb skipped in live-search path when child has no local comments
